about: Every Hinagata option by path (as in DEFAULTS, src/options.js). Generated by tools/schema.mjs from src/schema.js: edit those, not this file.

fields.type: number | boolean | color (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) | enum | image (path or data URL) | json (arrays, or any shape)
fields.soft: the range is a guess from the default; values outside it are allowed
fields.tier: main = shown in the editor / advanced = folded (fine-tuning)
fields.cost: what a change rebuilds: instant | paint (materials or painted attributes) | hair | clothes | body (body, clothes and hair)
fields.apply: the avatar method that applies it without a rebuild, or null
fields.alsoShapes: an instant change that also moves a shape on the next build
fields.order: main values: their place in the editor's panels
fields.when: { path: value }: the value only matters when those other values are set so ("*set": anything but null)

help.ja: [{ kind, bone, at, n, spin, size, color, mirror }] 体に付ける小物。kind: leaf(葉っぱ) / gem(宝石) / flower(花) / star(星) / ball(玉) / band(輪: 腕輪・足首・首)。bone の上に乗る。at: 頭なら頭の座標、ほかは骨の関節からのずれ。n: 向き(表面の向き)。spin: 向きのまわりの回転(度)。size: 大きさ(m、band は輪の太さ)。mirror: 反対側にも
help.en: [{ kind, bone, at, n, spin, size, color, mirror }] small pieces on the body. kind: leaf / gem / flower / star / ball / band (a ring around the limb: bracelet, anklet, choker), riding on bone. at: head space for the head, else the offset from the bone's joint. n: the way it faces (the surface's normal). spin: turned around n (degrees). size: m (a band: how thick the ring is). mirror: on the other side too
